summary: RFC-0058 drift: typed keys and pid walks still on main, how the drift is closed

options.description: Finish the migration to Mods site by site; delete a typed path only after its Mods replacement is proven in real runs; sites with no Mods path get a dated interim exception
Amend RFC-0058 with a dated interim exception for all sites, citing one upstream issue, and file one removal task
Read-only audit of every pane or pid heuristic first; nothing filed or amended until the operator has seen the list
Amend RFC-0058 to permit typed keys and pane reads as a permanent fallback

body: Problem: RFC-0058 forbids typed keys, pane reads and pid walks, but main still types /clear into standing executor panes, types roster messages, types /exit on shutdown and walks pids for caller identity. Ruling: finish the migration to Mods; a typed path is deleted only after its Mods replacement is proven working in real runs, because the October removal deleted first and left a broken system. Sites with no Mods path get a dated interim exception in the RFC. The options are those put to the operator through the decision rubric on 2026-11-18; recorded by the planner.
